name: A_REQUEST_RESET
description: Queue an IAM force-password-reset request for a resolved account (design §4). Input: account_owner (from A_RESOLVE_ACCOUNT_OWNER). Stub-safe: with no IAM creds it records a canned queued request (the demo stand-in for an IdP/IAM provisioning call) rather than performing a reset — the reset itself is a human/IAM action that belongs BEHIND a gate. Unknown owner ({ known: false }) yields { status: "skipped" }, never an error.
